# tritonctl profile

One config per cluster or project

Subcommands: list, show, create, use, delete

Usage: `tritonctl profile [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>`

## tritonctl profile list

List profiles; the one in use is marked

Alias: ls

Usage: `tritonctl profile list [OPTIONS]`

## tritonctl profile show

Show a profile's settings. Defaults to the one in use

Usage: `tritonctl profile show [OPTIONS] [NAME]`

- `<NAME>`

## tritonctl profile create

Create a profile. Log into it with `-p NAME login`

Usage: `tritonctl profile create [OPTIONS] --endpoint <ENDPOINT> <NAME>`

- `<NAME>`
- `--endpoint <ENDPOINT>` (required)
- `--sso-issuer <URL>`: Sign-in service for `login --sso`: `https://<sign-in host>/realms/<realm>`, the realm being your silo. Your administrator has it

## tritonctl profile use

Make a profile the one every later command uses

Usage: `tritonctl profile use [OPTIONS] <NAME>`

- `<NAME>`

## tritonctl profile delete

Delete a profile and its stored session

Alias: rm

Usage: `tritonctl profile delete [OPTIONS] <NAME>`

- `<NAME>`
- `-n, --dry-run`: Print what would change and stop
- `-y, --yes`: Answer yes to the confirmation. The summary still prints
- `--keep-going`: Keep executing after a step fails
